semiconductor_relevance: Medium — K-Max Technology Co., Ltd. provides specialized components and services that can support semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in precision machinery and environmental systems.
summary: K-Max Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the development and manufacturing of precision components and systems for high-tech and environmental protection industries. They offer customized services including electrostatic adsorption plates, heating plates, and various precision components that cater to advanced manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.Taiwan: K-Max Technology Co., Ltd. is based in Taipei, Taiwan, where it engages in the development of precision machinery and technology.
